review_method: Rendered Apple HIG pages were matched to canonical rules by official URL, section path, source hash, and source sentence hash; surrounding guidance was reviewed without persisting full source prose.

decision_policy.must: Retain MUST for an unqualified Always, Be sure, Ensure, Make sure, Must, or You must directive after checking its surrounding conditions and exceptions. Preserve accessibility, privacy, safety, security, user-intent, and platform-contract requirements at MUST.
decision_policy.must_not: Retain MUST_NOT for an explicit Never, must not, cannot or can't, Always avoid, or named prohibition after checking its surrounding conditions and exceptions.
decision_policy.mixed_strength: Split or narrow a candidate when mandatory and optional clauses occur in the same source lead; do not promote consider guidance to MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0006.review_note: Narrowed the mixed lead to the explicit Always logo requirement and split universal marks separately.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0012.title: Reverse progress and counting numeral sequences

statement.en: Reverse numeral sequences that show progress, counting direction, or a specific order in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextではprogress、counting direction、specific orderを示すnumeral sequenceを反転する。

conditions: Match the sequence to its flipped control or RTL ordering direction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0012.review_note: Split the mixed lead and retained MUST from the supporting Be sure directive.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0013.title: Never mirror numeral glyphs

statement.en: Never mirror numeral glyphs themselves in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextでもnumeral glyph自体を決してmirrorしない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0013.review_note: Split and retained the source's explicit Never prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0015.title: Reverse progress-control endpoint glyph positions

statement.en: When flipping a progress control, reverse accompanying glyphs or images that represent its endpoint values.
statement.ja: progress controlを反転するときはendpoint valueを表すglyphやimageの位置も反転する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0015.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure requirement as a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0016.title: Flip fixed-order navigation controls in RTL contexts

statement.en: Ensure fixed-order navigation controls flip to match RTL reading order.
statement.ja: fixed-order navigation controlをRTL reading orderに合わせて反転する。

conditions: Point Back rightward and flip Next or Previous controls for ordered lists.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0016.review_note: Recovered MUST from the supporting must and need-to requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0023.title: Flip forward and backward motion icons in RTL contexts

statement.en: Ensure icons that show forward or backward motion flip in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: forwardまたはbackward motionを示すiconをRTL contextで反転する。

conditions: Preserve motion meaning, including the direction of speaker sound waves.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0023.review_note: Recovered MUST from the supporting needs-to-flip requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0026.title: Preserve localization-independent icon-component language

statement.en: Ensure localization-independent icon components preserve their visual design language.
statement.ja: localization-independentなicon componentのvisual design languageを保つ。

conditions: Preserve components such as a negation backslash when the design language requires consistency.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0026.review_note: Recovered the conditional needs-to-adhere requirement as MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0027.title: Flip UI-representing icon badges with the interface

statement.en: Ensure an icon badge that represents actual UI flips when the represented interface flips.
statement.ja: actual UIを表すicon badgeをrepresented interfaceとともに反転する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0027.review_note: Recovered the conditional needs-to-flip UI representation requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0004.title: Ensure symbol animations communicate a clear purpose

statement.en: Ensure every symbol animation serves a clear purpose in communicating the symbol's intent.
statement.ja: 各symbol animationがsymbolのintentを伝える明確なpurposeを果たすようにする。

conditions: Evaluate how people may interpret each movement and whether one or more combined animations could be confusing.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0004.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure directive as MUST and fixed the duplicated generated statement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0012.title: Do not reproduce Apple products as custom symbols

statement.en: Do not reproduce Apple products in custom symbols.
statement.ja: Apple productをcustom symbolとして複製しない。

conditions: Apple products are copyrighted.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0012.review_note: Raised the direct Don't lead to MUST_NOT because the supporting legal statement explicitly says the copyrighted products can't be reproduced.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0018.title: Understand the SF Symbols terms and conditions

statement.en: Understand the SF Symbols terms and conditions before using the symbols.
statement.ja: symbolを使う前にSF Symbolsのterms and conditionsを理解する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0018.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure directive from the overview.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0019.title: Do not use SF Symbols for trademarked purposes

statement.en: Do not use SF Symbols or confusingly similar images in app icons, logos, or other trademarked uses.
statement.ja: SF Symbolsまたは紛らわしく類似したimageをapp icon、logo、その他のtrademarked useに使わない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0019.review_note: Split and retained the overview's explicit usage prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0029.title: Do not customize SF Symbols that depict Apple products

statement.en: Do not customize an SF Symbol that depicts an Apple product or feature.
statement.ja: Apple productまたはfeatureを表すSF Symbolをcustomizeしない。

conditions: The SF Symbols app identifies noncustomizable symbols with an Info badge and describes restrictions in the inspector.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0029.review_note: Recovered the explicit can't-customize restriction from the copyright callout.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0030.title: Use the naming pattern for custom-symbol margins

statement.en: When adding negative side margins to a custom symbol, use the documented configuration naming pattern.
statement.ja: custom symbolへnegative side marginを追加するときはdocumented configuration naming patternを使う。

conditions: Include the relevant configuration in names such as left-margin-Regular-M.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0030.review_note: Recovered the conditional be-sure requirement from the supporting margin prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0031.title: Annotate custom-symbol layers before by-layer animation

statement.en: Before animating a custom symbol by layer, annotate its layers in the SF Symbols app.
statement.ja: custom symbolをlayer単位でanimateする前にSF Symbols appでlayerをannotateする。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0031.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement from the supporting animation prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Display comfortable motion in a Full Space

statement.en: Display motion in comfortable ways while the experience runs in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで体験を実行するときは、快適な方法でmotionを表示する。

conditions: Prevent motion from causing distraction, confusion, or discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive from the visual-comfort supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Request permission before accessing sensitive surroundings data

statement.en: Request permission before accessing sensitive data about a person’s surroundings or hand positions.
statement.ja: 周囲環境や手の位置に関するsensitive dataへアクセスする前に、permissionを求める。

conditions: The experience uses ARKit data to blend custom content with a person’s surroundings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You must permission requirement and its sensitive-data condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Clarify what an immersive-experience exit control does

statement.en: Make an exit control clarify whether it reduces immersion or quits the experience.
statement.ja: exit controlがimmersionを下げるのか体験を終了するのかを明確にする。

conditions: An immersive experience provides an exit control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive while preserving the two distinct exit outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Never show excessive motion near the edges of the field of view

statement.en: Do not display excessive movement near the edges of a person’s field of view.
statement.ja: 利用者のfield of viewの端付近に過剰なmovementを表示しない。

conditions: The experience displays animation in a custom environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained MUST_NOT after confirming the explicit Always avoid directive.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when other audio plays

statement.en: Lower or stop the environmental soundscape when people can play other audio.
statement.ja: 利用者が別のaudioを再生できる場合、environmental soundscapeのvolumeを下げるか停止する。

conditions: People can play other audio while they use the environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive within its other-audio condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Always provide a ground plane in a custom environment

statement.en: Provide a ground plane mesh in a custom environment so people feel grounded.
statement.ja: 利用者がgroundedだと感じられるよう、custom environmentにground plane meshを設ける。

conditions: The app or game presents a custom environment in a Full Space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Always directive and its grounding purpose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0026.title: Support both landscape rotation directions

statement.en: Make a landscape-only iOS experience work equally well in both rotation directions.
statement.ja: landscape-onlyのiOS体験を左右どちらのrotation directionでも同等に動作させる。

conditions: The iOS app or game supports only landscape orientation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0026.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive within its landscape-only condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0027.title: Fit a necessary full-width iOS button to hardware and safe areas

statement.en: Make a necessary full-width iOS button harmonize with hardware curvature and adjacent safe areas.
statement.ja: 必要なfull-width iOS buttonをhardware curvatureと隣接safe areaに調和させる。

conditions: A full-width button is necessary despite the general guidance to avoid it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0027.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive without removing the full-width-button exception condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0030.title: Minimize unexpected UI changes while an iPadOS window resizes

statement.en: Minimize unexpected UI changes across the supported iPadOS window-size range.
statement.ja: 対応するiPadOS window-size range全体で予期しないUI変化を最小限にする。

conditions: A person resizes the window between its minimum and maximum supported sizes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0030.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive and its resizing range.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0032.title: Prevent focused tvOS elements from covering important information

statement.en: Prevent focused tvOS elements from overlapping important information.
statement.ja: focusされたtvOS elementがimportant informationと重ならないようにする。

conditions: A focus effect enlarges the element.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0032.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive as a positive non-overlap requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.title: Prevent focused tvOS grid items from overlapping

statement.en: Space unfocused tvOS grid rows and columns to prevent overlap when an item receives focus.
statement.ja: itemがfocusされたとき重ならないよう、unfocusedなtvOS gridのrowとcolumnを配置する。

conditions: The interface uses a tvOS grid whose items enlarge on focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure directive for grid focus spacing.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.title: Provide enough space around visionOS interactive components

statement.en: Provide enough space around visionOS interactive components for comfortable visual identification and unobscured hover effects.
statement.ja: comfortableなvisual identificationとhover effectのため、visionOS interactive componentの周囲に十分なspaceを設ける。

conditions: Prevent the system hover effect from obscuring other content.
The source gives 60-point center spacing as an example, not an unconditional minimum.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit You need directive without promoting the 60-point example to a universal threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.title: Match peripheral object brightness to surrounding content

statement.en: Match a moving peripheral object’s brightness to the rest of the visible content.
statement.ja: peripheral vision内のmoving objectのbrightnessを他のvisible contentに合わせる。

conditions: An immersive visionOS experience needs to show an object moving in peripheral vision.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure directive within its peripheral-motion exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0005.title: Keep every tvOS layered-image background opaque

statement.en: Keep the background layer of every tvOS layered image opaque.
statement.ja: すべてのtvOS layered imageでbackground layerをopaqueに保つ。

conditions: Higher layers may use varying opacity, but the background layer must remain opaque.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0005.review_note: Changed SHOULD to MUST after confirming the supporting must-be-opaque platform constraint and the error produced by a nonopaque background.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0018.title: Require layered images for the tvOS parallax effect

statement.en: Use a layered image whenever a tvOS image needs the parallax effect.
statement.ja: tvOS画像でparallax effectが必要な場合はlayered imageを使う。

conditions: Apply when an image needs to support the system parallax effect.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0018.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit required-to-support platform constraint and limited it to images that need parallax.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0019.title: Use a layered image for every tvOS app icon

statement.en: Use a layered image for every tvOS app icon.
statement.ja: すべてのtvOS app iconにlayered imageを使う。

conditions: This requirement applies to the app icon; other focusable images are recommended separately.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0019.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit app-icon must-use directive without extending it to optional focusable images.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0022.title: Provide runtime layered images for server-retrieved tvOS content

statement.en: Provide .lcr runtime layered images when a tvOS app retrieves layered images from a server.
statement.ja: tvOS appがserverからlayered imageを取得する場合は.lcr runtime layered imageを提供する。

conditions: The tvOS app retrieves layered images from a content server at runtime.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0022.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit conditional you-must-provide directive and preserved the runtime server-retrieval scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0028.title: Apply high-quality filtering above @2x in visionOS

statement.en: Apply high-quality image filtering to visionOS images with resolutions above @2x.
statement.ja: @2xを超えるvisionOS画像にhigh-quality image filteringを適用する。

conditions: The visionOS rasterized image has a resolution higher than @2x.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0028.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the conditional Be sure directive and its above-@2x threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0018.title: Specify visionOS type styles when using NY

statement.en: Specify every type style a visionOS app needs when it uses NY.
statement.ja: visionOS appでNYを使う場合は必要なtype styleをすべて指定する。

conditions: The visionOS app uses the NY typeface instead of relying only on SF Pro styles.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0018.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the conditional You need to specify platform requirement for NY type styles.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0021.title: Test nonwhite visionOS text colors in varied contexts

statement.en: Test every nonwhite visionOS text color in a variety of contexts.
statement.ja: white以外のvisionOS text colorをさまざまなcontextでtestする。

conditions: The design replaces the system’s default white text color.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0021.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the conditional Be sure to test directive for a nondefault text color.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.title: Use depth only when it adds value

statement.en: Use visionOS depth only where it clarifies, delights, or separates important content.
statement.ja: clarity、delight、important contentの分離に価値がある場合だけvisionOS depthを使う。

conditions: Prefer depth for large, important interface elements.
Review the frequency of depth changes because repeated refocusing can be tiring.
exceptions: Avoid depth that reduces legibility or usability on small objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.review_note: Retained MUST after reviewing the explicit Make sure lead and its value, scale, legibility, and refocusing limits.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0031.title: Ensure custom toolbar corner radii are concentric

statement.en: When creating a custom toolbar component, ensure its corner radius is concentric with the bar corners.
statement.ja: custom toolbar componentを作る場合はcorner radiusをbar cornerと同心にする。

conditions: Apply only when a standard toolbar component can't meet the need.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0031.review_note: Retained the conditional MUST from the explicit Ensure directive for custom toolbar components.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0033.title: Ensure custom Back and Close controls preserve standard behavior

statement.en: Ensure custom Back and Close controls preserve standard appearance, expected behavior, visual fit, and implementation consistency.
statement.ja: custom BackおよびClose controlでstandard appearance、expected behavior、visual fit、implementation consistencyを保つ。

conditions: Apply when creating a custom version instead of the standard Back or Close button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0033.review_note: Retained the conditional MUST from the source's Make sure and Ensure clauses.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0040.title: Reinstate standard visionOS toolbar controls after a modal state

statement.en: When a visionOS app exits a modal state, reinstate the window's standard toolbar controls.
statement.ja: visionOS appがmodal stateを終了したらwindowのstandard toolbar controlを復元する。

conditions: Apply when a modal task temporarily replaces the main window's toolbar controls.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOOLBARS-0040.review_note: Split the exit-state requirement from the optional modal-control recommendation and retained MUST from Be sure.

additional_rules.title: Consider setting a custom dismissal time for an ended Live Activity

statement.en: Evaluate whether a custom dismissal time is appropriate after a Live Activity ends.
statement.ja: Live Activity終了後にカスタム消去時刻を設定することが適切か検討する。

conditions: The Live Activity has ended and retaining a short-lived summary may help people.

rationale.en: A proportional dismissal time can preserve a useful summary without keeping stale activity visible too long.
rationale.ja: 適切な消去時刻は、古い情報を長く残さずに有用な概要を一時的に保持できます。

additional_rules.review_note: Split from the source lead's consider clause so optional guidance is not raised to MUST.

additional_rules.title: Ensure content remains legible in both appearance modes

statement.en: Ensure content remains comfortably legible in both appearance modes under relevant accessibility settings.
statement.ja: 関連するaccessibility settingの下でもcontentを両appearance modeで快適に読める状態にする。

conditions: Test Dark Mode with Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency both separately and together.

rationale.en: Appearance and accessibility combinations can reduce contrast enough to make content illegible.
rationale.ja: appearanceとaccessibility設定の組み合わせによりcontrastが低下し、contentが読めなくなる場合があります。

additional_rules.review_note: Split the explicit make-sure legibility outcome from the testing action so the accessibility requirement remains atomic.
